snippet.title: Kotama and Academy Citadel | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639650/
Kotama and Academy Citadel is a 3D Metroidvania game. Players assume the role of an exchange student named Kotama as she explores through the mysterious Academy Citadel, aiming to become the esteemed [Carmel Star].
